sentence: Lets a group tap the times that work for them from a short list, add their own options, and lock in the leading time once enough people agree.
use_when: A group needs to pick a time to meet, practice or hang out
Several candidate times exist and people can make more than one
Someone wants to see which time most people are free and then lock it
People need to suggest extra times to the list
dont_use_when: A single yes or no or a one-choice vote on a non-time question is needed
Two people just need to book one exact slot on a calendar
The group needs to split costs or assign tasks
